children: Tanzania may complete a new law that governs liquefied natural gas investments by the end of the year, deputy minister for energy Salome Wycliffe Makamba told reporters on the sidelines of the Gastech conference in Bangkok on Tuesday.

The new law could pave the way for a final investment decision on a long-stalled $42 billion project that would tap Tanzania's massive gas resources and provide an alternative source of supply for Asia.
